Axiom International Investors Holding in Apple (AAPL) Cut as Stock Declined; Akanthos Capital Management Maintains Stake in Chesapeake Energy (CHK) 
April 17, 2018 - By Ellis Scott 
Michael Kao increased its stake in Chesapeake Energy Corp (CHK) by 133.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Akanthos Capital Management Llc bought 1.00 million shares as the company’s stock declined 23.38% with the market. The hedge fund run by Michael Kao held 1.75 million shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.93M, up from 750,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Akanthos Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Chesapeake Energy Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.79B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.96% or $0.03 during the last trading session, reaching $3.11. About 27.70 million shares traded. Chesapeake Energy Corporation (NYSE:CHK) has declined 42.83% since April 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 54.38% the S&P500. 
Axiom International Investors Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 9.69% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Axiom International Investors Llc sold 39,776 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 370,529 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $62.71 million, down from 410,305 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Axiom International Investors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $892.11B market cap company. The stock increased 0.62% or $1.09 during the last trading session, reaching $175.82. About 20.26 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Among 33 analysts covering Chesapeake Energy Corporation ( NYSE:CHK ), 8 have Buy rating, 10 Sell and 15 Hold. Therefore 24% are positive. Chesapeake Energy Corporation had 96 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was maintained by Deutsche Bank on Wednesday, August 10 with “Hold”. The stock of Chesapeake Energy Corporation (NYSE:CHK) earned “Buy” rating by Bank of America on Monday, May 15. The firm earned “Market Perform” rating on Tuesday, November 3 by Bernstein. The rating was maintained by Deutsche Bank with “Hold” on Friday, March 11. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Friday, July 21 by Citigroup. The stock of Chesapeake Energy Corporation (NYSE:CHK) has “Hold” rating given on Wednesday, October 14 by Deutsche Bank. The firm has “Hold” rating by Piper Jaffray given on Wednesday, March 14. RBC Capital Markets downgraded Chesapeake Energy Corporation (NYSE:CHK) on Thursday, June 9 to “Underperform” rating. RBC Capital Markets maintained it with “Sector Perform” rating and $4 target in Thursday, February 25 report. The rating was downgraded by ValuEngine to “Sell” on Monday, May 29.
